comment: The fixed qualification prompt set for the Concierge benchmark harness. Every configured provider runs exactly these prompts, so numbers are comparable across providers and across runs. The lead conversations are built from the IntakeAgent question script (lib/agents.ts) and the sample leads in lib/lead.ts — same domain, same fields, no cherry-picking per provider.

prompts.prompt:
You are the qualification agent for Concierge, an AI receptionist for small luxury businesses. Below is a completed buyer intake conversation. Score how ready this buyer is to move forward and explain why.

Intake conversation:
Q: Are you shopping with a dealership, a realtor, or someone else?
A: dealer
Q: What are you looking for?
A: Grand touring coupe, V8, under 40k miles
Q: What budget range are you working with?
A: $70k-$85k
Q: How soon are you hoping to make a move?
A: This month
Q: Anything about your current situation that helps?
A: Trading in a 2021 sedan, one owner, dealer serviced
Q: Photo
A: Sent a photo of the trade-in. Condition grade B: clean overall, minor curb rash on one wheel.
Q: If we find the right fit, when would you want to come in?
A: Saturday morning test drive
Q: Name and contact?
A: Marcus Bell, marcus.b@example.com

Respond with JSON only, in exactly this shape: {"readinessScore": <0-100>, "reasons": [<short strings>], "followUpOpener": "<one sentence>"}
